identity.ref: nftneo.eth (Ethereum); identity NFT held by the vault

runtime.model: TensorX-hosted open-weight model for reading and drafting; a frontier model for acquisition decisions

permitted_universe.ref: Fully on-chain generative art on Ethereum, per the published Canon

caps.note: Daily cap set in the Safe session-key policy; the value is published in the custody/ directory of the nftneo repository and will be mirrored here on activation.

operational: acquire a work inside the daily cap on an allowlisted venue

revocation.by: Human owner (2-of-3 Safe owner with hardware wallet)
revocation.mechanism: Timelocked owner override on the Safe; visible on-chain

enforcement.mechanism: Safe session-key module policy: no transfer of any NFT out, no arbitrary calls
Safe module allows execution only via allowlisted contracts
Turnkey enclave policy mirrors the Safe module; exposes one operation, sign_purchase
The reasoning container holds no private key; a separate message-only key signs publications

audit.format: Append-only JSONL, signed commits; every valuation published before the purchase, outcomes appended, misses included

index_note: Pre-launch: the mandate is published and the custody policy is in the repository; no acquisition has been made yet. Status becomes 'active' with the first ledger entry.
